images.title: Qumran aqueduct outlet
images.author: SuperJew
images.transformation: None; original JPEG bytes retained. Interactive display pan/zoom does not alter the archived file.
images.caption: An actual surviving waterwork at Qumran: the source identifies this as an aqueduct exit into a cistern. This is a close-up photograph, not a panorama or 360-degree capture. It does not show the upstream intake, dam, full channel, or an identified Copper Scroll hiding place.
images.spatial_limit: A flat photograph with its recorded inspection scope; not a 360-degree panorama, registered camera pose or texture reconstruction.
